sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across H.G. Wells speculative theater classics, breezy morning vocal pop duets, beloved domestic sitcoms, Australian flying doctor adventures, and Arkansas country comedy, Sir Laurence Olivier in *The Country of the Blind* on *Theatre Royal* (1954), Bing Crosby and Rosemary Clooney (1961), Robert Young in *Father Knows Best* (1949), *Lum and Abner* for Frigidaire (1948), and *The Flying Doctor* (1938–1961):
